exercises.instructionUz: Bu odamlar haqida namunadagidek savol-javob qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  S1: Who was John F. Kennedy?
  S2: He was an American president. When was he born?
  S3: He was born in 1917. When did he die?
  S4: He died in 1963.

UCHTA SAVOL QOLIPI:

  1) WHO WAS + ism?          → Kim edi?
     Javob: He/She WAS + kasb.

  2) WHEN WAS he/she BORN?   → Qachon tug'ilgan?
     Javob: He/She WAS BORN IN + yil.

  3) WHEN DID he/she DIE?    → Qachon vafot etgan?
     Javob: He/She DIED IN + yil.

ENG MUHIM QOIDA — 'BE BORN':
  Ingliz tilida 'tug'ilmoq' — MAJHUL nisbatda:
     I WAS BORN in 2010.        ✓
     I BORN in 2010.            ✗ XATO
     I WAS BORNED in 2010.      ✗ XATO
  So'zma-so'z: 'tug'ilgan bo'ldim'.

DIQQAT — 'DIE' esa ODDIY fe'l:
  He DIED in 1963.        ✓
  He WAS DIED in 1963.    ✗ XATO
  So'roqda: 'When DID he DIE?' — 'did' + asosiy shakl.

DIQQAT — YIL OLDIDAN 'IN':
  in 1917, in 1963 — yil oldidan DOIM IN.

DIQQAT — KASB OLDIDAN ARTIKL:
  He was AN American president.  (bir nechtadan biri → A/AN)
  She was THE Queen of England.  (o'sha davrda YAGONA → THE)
  She was THE Princess of Wales. (yagona unvon → THE)

exercises.instructionEn: Explain the verbs in the list.

exercises.explanationUz:
O'N TO'RT FE'L — HAMMASI O'TGAN ZAMONDA:
  died, divorced, watched, studied, married, continued,
  returned, loved, said, worked, cared, completed,
  called, appeared

Bu fe'llar 71-betdagi Diananing tarjimai holidagi
bo'shliqlarga qo'yiladi.

ENG MUHIM QOIDA — ODDIY O'TGAN ZAMON:
  Ko'pchilik fe'lga -ED qo'shiladi:
     work → worked;  love → loved;  study → studied

  -ED QO'ShIShNING UCH QOIDASI:
     1) oddiy holat        → + ED    (work → worked)
     2) oxirida -E bo'lsa  → + D     (love → loved,
                                      divorce → divorced)
     3) undosh + Y bo'lsa  → Y→I+ED  (study → studied)

  ISTISNO — NOTO'G'RI FE'L:
     say → SAID  (-ed QO'ShILMAYDI!)
     Ro'yxatdagi YAGONA noto'g'ri fe'l.

-ED NING UCH XIL O'QILISHI:
  /t/  — jarangsiz tovushdan keyin: worked, watched
  /d/  — jarangli tovushdan keyin: loved, called, appeared
  /ɪd/ — 't' yoki 'd' dan keyin: completed, divorced?
         (aniq: wanted /ˈwɒntɪd/, needed /ˈniːdɪd/)

exercises.instructionEn: A Fairy-Tale Princess — read the article.
exercises.instructionUz: Ertakdagidek malika — maqolani o'qing.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ MATN (to'ldirilgan holda):

  A FAIRY-TALE PRINCESS

  It was like a fairy tale when the beautiful young girl
  married the Prince and became the Princess of Wales.
  Unlike a fairy tale, the happiness soon ended, but Diana
  was still The People's Princess.

  1) Diana Frances Spencer was born on 1st July, 1961, in
     Norfolk, England. Her father was Earl Spencer. She had
     two older sisters and a younger brother. Her parents
     DIVORCED when she was a young girl. As a child, Diana
     STUDIED at a boarding school in Kent. She COMPLETED
     her education in Switzerland. When she RETURNED to
     England she WORKED as a nanny in London.

  2) Diana MARRIED Prince Charles in July, 1981, at St
     Paul's Cathedral in London. People all around the world
     WATCHED her wedding on television. Charles and Diana
     had two sons, William and Harry.

  3) Diana was very popular. The British LOVED her for her
     kindness and beauty. They CALLED her "The People's
     Princess" because she CARED so much about sick and poor
     people all over the world. She once SAID, "I see myself
     as a princess for the world, not the Princess of
     Wales." Reporters were always around her. She was their
     favourite person.

  4) But Diana's life wasn't as happy as it APPEARED. She
     and Charles had problems with their marriage. They
     finally divorced in August, 1996.

  5) Diana CONTINUED to travel round the world and help
     those in need. But her life was short — she DIED in a
     car accident on 31st August, 1997, in Paris. She was
     only thirty-six years old.


O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:

  ERTAKDAGIDEK MALIKA

  Go'zal yosh qiz shahzodaga turmushga chiqib, Uels
  malikasi bo'lganida bu xuddi ertakdek edi. Lekin
  ertakdan farqli o'laroq, baxt tez orada tugadi —
  ammo Diana baribir Xalq Malikasi bo'lib qoldi.

  1) Diana Frensis Spenser 1961-yil 1-iyulda Angliyaning
     Norfolk shahrida tug'ilgan. Otasi Erl Spenser edi.
     Uning ikkita katta opasi va bitta kichik ukasi bor
     edi. U yosh qiz bo'lganida ota-onasi ajrashdi. Bolalik
     chog'ida Diana Kentdagi internat maktabida o'qidi.
     Ta'limini Shveytsariyada tugatdi. Angliyaga qaytgach,
     Londonda enaga bo'lib ishladi.

  2) Diana 1981-yil iyulda Londondagi Avliyo Pavel
     soborida shahzoda Charlzga turmushga chiqdi. Butun
     dunyo odamlari uning to'yini televizorda tomosha
     qilishdi. Charlz va Diananing ikkita o'g'li bor edi —
     Uilyam va Garri.

  3) Diana juda mashhur edi. Britaniyaliklar uni
     mehribonligi va go'zalligi uchun sevishardi. Ular uni
     "Xalq Malikasi" deb atashdi, chunki u butun dunyodagi
     kasal va kambag'al odamlar haqida juda qayg'urardi.
     U bir marta shunday degan edi: "Men o'zimni Uels
     malikasi emas, balki butun dunyo uchun malika deb
     bilaman." Jurnalistlar doim uning atrofida edi.
     U ularning sevimli shaxsi edi.

  4) Lekin Diananing hayoti ko'ringanchalik baxtli emas edi.
     U va Charlz nikohlarida muammolarga duch kelishdi.
     Ular nihoyat 1996-yil avgustda ajrashdilar.

  5) Diana dunyo bo'ylab sayohat qilishni va muhtojlarga
     yordam berishni davom ettirdi. Lekin uning umri qisqa
     bo'ldi — u 1997-yil 31-avgustda Parijda avtohalokatda
     halok bo'ldi. U atigi o'ttiz olti yoshda edi.


MATN TUZILISHI (5 xatboshi):
  1  Bolalik va ta'lim
  2  To'y va farzandlar
  3  Mashhurligi va xalq mehri
  4  Nikohdagi muammolar va ajralish
  5  Fojiali oxir

UNIT MAVZUSI BILAN BOG'LIQLIGI:
  'The Price of Fame' — shuhratning narxi.
  Diana mashhur edi, lekin jurnalistlar doim atrofida edi
  va shaxsiy hayoti buzildi. Shuhratning 'narxi' shu.

tasks.note:
70-betdagi 3-mashqning 3-bandi shu gapdan olingan (T).
'the British' — millat nomi oldidan THE.

tasks.en: They called her "The People's Princess" because she cared so much about sick and poor people.
tasks.uz: Ular uni "Xalq Malikasi" deb atashdi, chunki u kasal va kambag'al odamlar haqida juda qayg'urardi.

'care ABOUT' = qayg'urmoq, befarq bo'lmaslik.
'The People'S' — apostrof egalik bildiradi.

tasks.en: Reporters were always around her. She was their favourite person.
tasks.uz: Jurnalistlar doim uning atrofida edi. U ularning sevimli shaxsi edi.

'a reporter' = jurnalist, muxbir.
SHUHRATNING NARXI shu — tinchlik yo'q.

tasks.en: But Diana's life wasn't as happy as it appeared.
tasks.uz: Lekin Diananing hayoti ko'ringanchalik baxtli emas edi.
tasks.note:
'AS happy AS' — tenglik darajasi.
'to appear' = ko'rinmoq (bu yerda 'aslida undoq emas' ma'nosida).

tasks.en: They finally divorced in August, 1996.
tasks.note:

tasks.en: Diana continued to travel round the world and help those in need.

'those in need' = muhtojlar.

tasks.en: She died in a car accident on 31st August, 1997, in Paris. She was only thirty-six years old.

70-betdagi 3-mashqning 4-bandi shu gapga asoslanadi:
'a train accident' XATO — A CAR ACCIDENT.
'die IN an accident' — predlog IN.

exercises.instructionEn: Read Diana's biography and fill in the gaps with the correct verbs.
exercises.instructionUz: Diananing tarjimai holini o'qing va bo'shliqlarni to'g'ri fe'llar bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (70-betdan, 14 ta fe'l):
  died, divorced, watched, studied, married, continued,
  returned, loved, said, worked, cared, completed,
  called, appeared

14 fe'l, 14 bo'shliq — har biri AYNAN BIR MARTA.
Bu tekshirish uchun yaxshi belgi.

USUL: har bir bo'shliq atrofidagi so'zlarga qarang.
  ... at a boarding school → o'qish → studied
  ... as a nanny          → ishlash → worked
  ... in a car accident    → o'lim  → died

HAMMA FE'L O'TGAN ZAMONDA (-ed),
chunki matn tarixiy voqealar haqida.

tasks.prompt: 1  Her parents ............ when she was a young girl.
tasks.whyUz:
'Her parents DIVORCED' = ota-onasi ajrashdi.
DIQQAT: 'divorce' bu yerda 'ajrashmoq' — to'ldiruvchi kerak emas.
4-xatboshida yana chiqadi: 'They finally divorced in 1996'.
tasks.speak: 1  Her parents ............ when she was a young girl.

tasks.prompt: 2  As a child, Diana ............ at a boarding school in Kent.
tasks.whyUz:
'STUDIED at a school' = maktabda o'qidi.
study → studied (undosh + Y → I + ED).
'a boarding school' = internat maktab.
tasks.speak: 2  As a child, Diana ............ at a boarding school in Kent.

tasks.whyUz:
'COMPLETED her education' = ta'limini tugatdi.
'complete' = tugatmoq, yakunlamoq.
-ed /ɪd/ deb o'qiladi (oxiri 't').

'RETURNED to England' = Angliyaga qaytdi.
'return TO a place' — 'to' shart.
Shveytsariyadan qaytgan.

tasks.prompt: 5  ... she ............ as a nanny in London.
tasks.whyUz:
'WORKED as a nanny' = enaga bo'lib ishladi.
'work AS' — 'as' shart.
'a nanny' = enaga.
70-betdagi 3-mashqning 2-bandi shu gapga asoslanadi.
tasks.speak: 5  ... she ............ as a nanny in London.

tasks.whyUz:
'MARRIED Prince Charles' = shahzoda Charlzga turmushga chiqdi.
marry → married (undosh + Y → I + ED).
DIQQAT: 'married WITH Charles' XATO — 'with' KERAK EMAS.

tasks.prompt: 7  People all around the world ............ her wedding on television.
tasks.whyUz:
'WATCHED her wedding' = to'yini tomosha qilishdi.
'watch' — televizor va tomoshalar uchun
('see' emas, WATCH).
-ed /t/ deb o'qiladi.
tasks.speak: 7  People all around the world ............ her wedding on television.

tasks.prompt: 8  The British ............ her for her kindness and beauty.
tasks.whyUz:
'LOVED her' = uni sevishardi.
'love somebody FOR something' = biror fazilati uchun sevmoq.
70-betdagi 3-mashqning 3-bandi (T) shu gapdan.
tasks.speak: 8  The British ............ her for her kindness and beauty.

tasks.whyUz:
'CALLED her ...' = uni ... deb atashdi.
'call somebody + nom' — orada predlog YO'Q:
  They called her The People's Princess.  ✓
  They called her AS ...                  ✗ XATO

tasks.prompt: 10  ... because she ............ so much about sick and poor people.
tasks.whyUz:
'CARED about ...' = ... haqida qayg'urardi.
'care ABOUT' = befarq bo'lmaslik.
'care FOR' = parvarish qilmoq (biroz boshqa ma'no).
'so much' = juda ko'p.
tasks.speak: 10  ... because she ............ so much about sick and poor people.

tasks.prompt: 11  She once ............ , "I see myself as a princess for the world ..."
tasks.whyUz:
'SAID' = dedi.
Qo'shtirnoq ochilsa — gapirish fe'li kerak.
DIQQAT: 'say' — NOTO'G'RI fe'l:
  say → SAID  (-ed QO'ShILMAYDI)
Ro'yxatdagi YAGONA noto'g'ri fe'l.
'once' bu yerda = bir marta.
tasks.speak: 11  She once ............ , "I see myself as a princess for the world ..."

tasks.prompt: 12  But Diana's life wasn't as happy as it ............ .
tasks.whyUz:
'as happy as it APPEARED' = ko'ringanchalik baxtli.
'to appear' = ko'rinmoq, tuyulmoq.
Ma'nosi: tashqaridan baxtli ko'rinardi, aslida emas —
SHUHRATNING NARXI.
tasks.speak: 12  But Diana's life wasn't as happy as it ............ .

tasks.prompt: 13  Diana ............ to travel round the world and help those in need.
tasks.whyUz:
'CONTINUED to travel' = sayohat qilishni davom ettirdi.
'continue TO + fe'l' qolipi.
'those in need' = muhtojlar.
tasks.speak: 13  Diana ............ to travel round the world and help those in need.

tasks.prompt: 14  She ............ in a car accident on 31st August, 1997, in Paris.
tasks.whyUz:
'DIED in a car accident' = avtohalokatda halok bo'ldi.
die → died (-e ga faqat -D).
70-betdagi 3-mashqning 4-bandi (F) shu gapga asoslanadi:
poyezd emas, MAShINA halokati.
tasks.speak: 14  She ............ in a car accident on 31st August, 1997, in Paris.

tasks.en: Explain the words in bold in the text.
education

Fe'li: 'to educate' = ta'lim bermoq.

Boshqa oilaning bolalariga qaraydigan ayol.
DIQQAT: 'a nurse' (hamshira) BILAN ADAShTIRMANG —
70-betdagi 3-mashqda shu farq tekshiriladi.

tasks.en: a Prince
tasks.note:
'She married PRINCE Charles.'
Qirol yoki qirolichaning o'g'li.
Ayol jinsi: 'a Princess' = malika.

tasks.en: a wedding

Turmush qurish MAROSIMI (bir kunlik voqea).
DIQQAT: 'a marriage' — NIKOH (uzoq davom etadigan holat).

tasks.en: kindness

Sifat: 'kind' = mehribon.

tasks.en: a Princess

'They called her The People's PRINCESS.'
Shahzodaning xotini yoki qirolning qizi.
-ESS qo'shimchasi ayol jinsini bildiradi:

tasks.en: sick

= 'ill' bilan bir xil ma'no.

Aksi: 'rich' = boy.

exercises.instructionEn: Then, answer the questions below.
exercises.instructionUz: So'ng quyidagi savollarga javob bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
Har bir savolning javobi matnda BOR.
To'liq gap bilan javob bering.

SAVOL SO'ZLARI:
  When ...?     → vaqt
  Where ...?    → joy
  How many ...? → son
  Why ...?      → sabab (javob 'Because ...')
  Was ...?      → ha/yo'q (qisqa javob + tushuntirish)

tasks.prompt: 1  When and where was Diana born?
tasks.answer: She was born on 1st July, 1961, in Norfolk, England.
tasks.whyUz:
IKKI savol birga: WHEN (vaqt) + WHERE (joy).
'was born ON + sana' — aniq sana bilan ON.
'IN Norfolk, England' — joy bilan IN.
tasks.speak: 1  When and where was Diana born?

tasks.answer: She studied at a boarding school in Kent and completed her education in Switzerland.
tasks.whyUz:
Matnda IKKI joy bor:
'a boarding school in Kent' va 'Switzerland'.
Ikkalasini ham aytish kerak — biri qoldirilsa javob to'liq emas.
'study AT a school' — predlog AT.

tasks.prompt: 3  When and where did she marry Prince Charles?
tasks.answer: She married him in July, 1981, at St Paul's Cathedral in London.
tasks.whyUz:
'IN July, 1981' — oy va yil bilan IN.
'AT St Paul's Cathedral' — aniq bino bilan AT.
Savolda 'did ... marry' (asosiy shakl),
javobda 'married' (o'tgan shakl).
tasks.speak: 3  When and where did she marry Prince Charles?

tasks.prompt: 4  How many children did they have?
tasks.answer: They had two sons, William and Harry.
tasks.whyUz:
'How many ...?' — SANALADIGAN ot bilan.
Javob: ikkita o'g'il — Uilyam va Garri.
Savolda 'did ... have', javobda 'had'.
tasks.speak: 4  How many children did they have?

tasks.answer: Because the British loved her for her kindness and beauty, and because she cared so much about sick and poor people all over the world.
tasks.whyUz:
'Why ...?' savoliga 'BECAUSE ...' bilan javob beriladi.
IKKI sabab bor: mehribonligi/go'zalligi va
kasal-kambag'allarga qayg'urishi.

tasks.prompt: 6  Was her life as happy as it appeared?
tasks.answer: No, it wasn't. She and Charles had problems with their marriage.
tasks.whyUz:
'Was ...?' savoliga qisqa javob: 'No, it wasn't.'
So'ng sabab tushuntiriladi.
'as happy as' — tenglik darajasi.
Bu — unitning asosiy g'oyasi: shuhrat baxt keltirmaydi.
tasks.speak: 6  Was her life as happy as it appeared?

tasks.whyUz:
'IN August, 1996' — oy va yil bilan IN.
Savolda 'did ... divorce', javobda 'divorced'.

tasks.prompt: 8  When and where did she die?
tasks.answer: She died on 31st August, 1997, in a car accident in Paris.
tasks.whyUz:
'ON 31st August, 1997' — aniq sana bilan ON.
'IN Paris' — shahar bilan IN.
'IN a car accident' — halokat bilan IN.
tasks.speak: 8  When and where did she die?

exercises.instructionEn: In the Public Eye — read the article about the Backstreet Boys.
exercises.instructionUz: Xalq nazarida — Backstreet Boys haqidagi maqolani o'qing.
exercises.explanationUz:
SARLAVHA: 'In the Public Eye'
  = xalq nazarida, hammaning ko'z o'ngida.
  Mashhur odamlar haqida ishlatiladigan ibora.

TO'LIQ MATN:

  They are young, talented and famous. They are the
  Backstreet Boys, or BSB FOR SHORT, an ALL-BOY BAND from
  America.

  The band started with Howie Dorough, AJ McLean and Nick
  Carter.

  AJ worked as a model when he was six. He also acted in
  school PLAYS. When he was fourteen, he got to know Howie.
  Howie had ROLES in films and plays. They became friends
  and went to AUDITIONS together. They met Nick at one of
  those auditions. Nick's parents had a disco and Nick used
  to dance there. The three of them started singing
  together for a RECORD COMPANY called Transcontinental
  Records.

  The record company OWNER, Lou Perlman, had a friend who
  knew Kevin Richardson. Kevin had a job at Disney World in
  Orlando at the time. When Lou's friend told Kevin about
  the new group, Kevin decided to meet them. The four
  became friends and Kevin JOINED THE GROUP. Lou wanted one
  more person for the group. The fifth member was Brian
  Littrell, Kevin's cousin.

  BSB released their first album in 1996. They received
  their first GOLD RECORD in Germany for this album. A
  second album followed in late 1997.

  BSB have got FANS in many countries. Do you want to write
  to them? Their address is: Backstreet Boys, Post Office
  Box 618203, Orlando, FL 32861-8203.


O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:

  Ular yosh, iqtidorli va mashhur. Ular — Backstreet Boys,
  qisqacha BSB, Amerikadan kelgan faqat o'g'il bolalardan
  iborat guruh.

  Guruh Xaui Doro, EY-Jey Maklin va Nik Karter bilan
  boshlangan.

  EY-Jey olti yoshida model bo'lib ishlagan. Shuningdek
  maktab spektakllarida rol o'ynagan. O'n to'rt yoshida
  Xaui bilan tanishgan. Xaui film va spektakllarda rollar
  o'ynagan edi. Ular do'stlashib, birga tinglovlarga
  borishgan. Nikni ana shu tinglovlarning birida
  uchratishgan. Nikning ota-onasining diskotekasi bor edi
  va Nik u yerda raqsga tushardi. Uchovi birgalikda
  Transcontinental Records nomli yozuv kompaniyasi uchun
  qo'shiq ayta boshladi.

  Yozuv kompaniyasining egasi Lu Perlmanning Kevin
  Richardsonni taniydigan do'sti bor edi. O'sha paytda
  Kevin Orlandodagi Disney Worldda ishlardi. Luning do'sti
  Kevinga yangi guruh haqida aytganda, Kevin ular bilan
  uchrashishga qaror qildi. To'rtovi do'stlashdi va Kevin
  guruhga qo'shildi. Lu guruhga yana bitta odam xohlardi.
  Beshinchi a'zo Kevinning amakivachchasi Brayan Littrell
  bo'ldi.

  BSB birinchi albomini 1996-yilda chiqardi. Shu albom
  uchun Germaniyada birinchi oltin plastinkasini oldi.
  Ikkinchi albom 1997-yil oxirida chiqdi.

  BSB ning ko'p mamlakatlarda muxlislari bor. Ularga xat
  yozmoqchimisiz? Manzillari: Backstreet Boys, Post Office
  Box 618203, Orlando, FL 32861-8203.


BESH A'ZO VA ULAR QANDAY QO'ShILGAN:
  1-3) Howie, AJ, Nick — guruhni BOSHLAGANLAR
  4)   Kevin Richardson — Lu ning do'sti orqali qo'shilgan
  5)   Brian Littrell — Kevinning AMAKIVACHCHASI

UNIT MAVZUSI BILAN BOG'LIQLIGI:
  Diana va Motsart kabi, BSB ham 'in the public eye' —
  xalq nazarida. Lekin bu yerda shuhratning YAXShI tomoni
  ko'rsatilgan: yosh, iqtidorli, muvaffaqiyatli.

            YOKI
            August the twenty-sixth, nineteen fifty-nine

IKKI XIL AYTISH USULI:

  1-USUL:  THE + tartib son + OF + oy + yil
           the twenty-sixth of August, nineteen fifty-nine

           August the twenty-sixth, nineteen fifty-nine

  1st  = the first        2nd  = the second
  3rd  = the third        4th  = the fourth

  13th = the thirteenth   16th = the sixteenth
  21st = the twenty-first 25th = the twenty-fifth
  29th = the twenty-ninth 31st = the thirty-first

  Yil IKKI JUFTGA bo'linadi:
     1959 → 19 | 59 → nineteen fifty-nine
     1935 → 19 | 35 → nineteen thirty-five
     1825 → 18 | 25 → eighteen twenty-five
     1899 → 18 | 99 → eighteen ninety-nine

  ISTISNO — oxiri '00' bo'lsa:
     1900 → nineteen hundred
     1980 → nineteen eighty  ('nineteen eight-oh' EMAS)
     2000 → two thousand
     2010 → two thousand and ten / twenty ten

DIQQAT — BRITAN va AMERIKA YOZILISHI FARQ QILADI:
  Britancha:  26/8/1959  (kun/oy/yil)
  Amerikacha: 8/26/1959  (oy/kun/yil)

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the table, then say how we form the past simple.
exercises.instructionUz: Jadvalga qarang, so'ng oddiy o'tgan zamon qanday yasalishini ayting.
exercises.explanationUz:
PAST SIMPLE FORM (jadval):

  TASDIQ       I/you/he, etc  WATCHED TV last night.
  INKOR        I/you/he, etc  DIDN'T WATCH TV last night.
  SO'ROQ       DID I/you/he, etc  WATCH TV last night?
  QISQA JAVOB  Yes, I/you/he, etc DID.
               No,  I/you/he, etc DIDN'T.

QANDAY YASALADI:

  TASDIQ:  fe'l + -ED  (yoki noto'g'ri fe'l shakli)
           watch → watched;  make → made
           HAMMA EGA UCHUN BIR XIL — -s YO'Q!

  INKOR:   DIDN'T + fe'lning ASOSIY shakli
           I didn't WATCH   ✓
           I didn't WATCHED ✗ XATO

  SO'ROQ:  DID + ega + fe'lning ASOSIY shakli
           Did you WATCH?   ✓
           Did you WATCHED? ✗ XATO

  QISQA JAVOB: did / didn't (asosiy fe'l TAKRORLANMAYDI)
           Yes, I did.      ✓
           Yes, I watched.  ✗

ENG MUHIM QOIDA:
  'DID' yoki 'DIDN'T' bor bo'lsa — fe'l ASOSIY shaklda.
  Sababi: 'did' allaqachon o'tgan zamonni ko'rsatgan.
  Bu — 9-unitdagi 'didn't have' qoidasining o'zi.

USE (ishlatilishi):
  Past simple ni O'TMISHDA sodir bo'lgan va QAYTA
  TAKRORLANMAYDIGAN harakatlar uchun ishlatamiz.
     Diana MARRIED Prince Charles in July, 1981.
     (When did she marry him? In July, 1981.)

  VAQT IBORALARI (past simple belgilari):
     yesterday       = kecha
     ... ago         = ...oldin
     in 1950         = 1950-yilda
     last Monday     = o'tgan dushanba
     last week/month = o'tgan hafta/oy

WAS/WERE BILAN SOLISHTIRING (9-unit):
  'to be'  → did KERAK EMAS:  Were you at home?
  boshqa fe'l → did KERAK:    Did you watch TV?

TO'LIQ MATN (to'ldirilgan holda):

  Marie Sklodowska (Marie Curie) was a famous scientist.
  She was born in 1867 in Warsaw, Poland. She studied
  physics and mathematics at the Sorbonne in Paris. She
  married Pièrre Curie in 1895. Together they discovered
  polonium and radium in 1898. In 1903, the Curies received
  the Nobel Prize for Physics. Pièrre died in a road
  accident in 1906. Marie continued their work on radium.
  In 1911, she received the Nobel Prize for Chemistry.
  She died of leukaemia in 1934.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Mariya Sklodovska (Mari Kyuri) mashhur olima edi.
  U 1867-yilda Polshaning Varshava shahrida tug'ilgan.
  U Parijdagi Sorbonnada fizika va matematika o'qidi.
  1895-yilda Pyer Kyuriga turmushga chiqdi. Ular birgalikda
  1898-yilda poloniy va radiyni kashf etishdi. 1903-yilda
  Kyurilar fizika bo'yicha Nobel mukofotini olishdi.
  Pyer 1906-yilda yo'l-transport hodisasida halok bo'ldi.
  Mariya radiy ustidagi ishlarini davom ettirdi. 1911-yilda
  u kimyo bo'yicha Nobel mukofotini oldi. U 1934-yilda
  leykemiyadan vafot etdi.

JAVOBLAR QAYERDAN OLINDI:
  1867 va 1934 — 70-betdagi rasm izohida yozilgan
                 ('Polish scientist 1867 - 1934').
  Qolgan yillar — tarixiy faktlar.
  Kitobning o'zida bu javoblar YO'Q — o'qituvchi aytadi.

  mathematics  = matematika
  to discover  = kashf etmoq
  to receive   = olmoq
  the Nobel Prize = Nobel mukofoti
  chemistry    = kimyo
  a road accident = yo'l-transport hodisasi
  leukaemia    = leykemiya (qon saratoni)

exercises.instructionEn: Spelling rules for the past simple.
exercises.instructionUz: Oddiy o'tgan zamonning yozilish qoidalari.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI TO'RT QOIDA:

  1) Ko'pchilik TO'G'RI fe'lga -ED qo'shamiz.
        I work  →  I worked

  2) Oxiri -E bilan tugagan fe'lga faqat -D qo'shamiz.
        I love  →  I loved

  3) UNDOSH + Y bilan tugagan fe'lda -Y tushadi,
     o'rniga -IED qo'shiladi.
        I study  →  I studied

  4) Boshqa fe'llarning NOTO'G'RI shakli bor.
        become  →  became
        say     →  said
     Kitobning OXIRIDAGI noto'g'ri fe'llar ro'yxatiga qarang.

ENG MUHIM DIQQAT — 3-QOIDA FAQAT UNDOSH + Y UCHUN:

  UNDOSH + Y  →  Y tushadi, -IED
     stUDy   → studied   (d — undosh)
     marRY   → married   (r — undosh)
     carRY   → carried
     buRY    → buried
     tRY     → tried

  UNLI + Y   →  Y QOLADI, faqat -ED
     enjOY   → enjoyed   (o — unli)
     plAY    → played    (a — unli)
     stAY    → stayed

  12-mashqdagi 'BUT enjoy' shu farqni ko'rsatish uchun.

QO'ShIMCHA QOIDA (kitobda yo'q, lekin foydali):
  Bir bo'g'inli, oxiri UNDOSH+UNLI+UNDOSH bo'lgan fe'lda
  oxirgi undosh IKKILANADI:
     stop → stopped;  plan → planned;  travel → travelled

TO'LIQ MATN (to'ldirilgan holda):

  Sir Alexander Fleming WAS a famous scientist. He was born
  in Scotland on 6th August, 1881. He STUDIED medicine at
  St Mary's Hospital in London. After World War I, he
  RETURNED to St Mary's and WORKED there as a professor.

  In 1915, he MARRIED Sarah Marion McElroy and they HAD a
  son. He DISCOVERED penicillin in 1928 and RECEIVED the
  Nobel Prize for Medicine in 1945. His wife DIED in 1949.
  Fleming married again in 1953. His second wife WAS a
  Greek doctor, Dr Amalia Koutsouris.

  Fleming DIED on 11th March, 1955. They BURIED him in
  St Paul's Cathedral.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Ser Aleksandr Fleming mashhur olim edi. U 1881-yil
  6-avgustda Shotlandiyada tug'ilgan. U Londondagi Avliyo
  Meri kasalxonasida tibbiyot o'qidi. Birinchi jahon
  urushidan keyin Avliyo Meriga qaytdi va u yerda professor
  bo'lib ishladi.
  1915-yilda Sara Marion Makelroyga uylandi va ularning
  o'g'li bo'ldi. U 1928-yilda penitsillinni kashf etdi va
  1945-yilda tibbiyot bo'yicha Nobel mukofotini oldi.
  Xotini 1949-yilda vafot etdi. Fleming 1953-yilda qayta
  uylandi. Ikkinchi xotini yunon shifokori — doktor Amaliya
  Kutsuris edi.
  Fleming 1955-yil 11-martda vafot etdi. Uni Avliyo Pavel
  soborida dafn etishdi.

  HAVE → HAD  (6-band)
  Qolgan hammasi TO'G'RI fe'l (-ed oladi).

  bury → BURIED  ('r' undosh + 'y' → -IED).

DIQQAT — DIANA BILAN BOG'LIQLIK:
  Fleming ham 'St Paul's Cathedral' da —

  World War I    = Birinchi jahon urushi

exercises.instructionEn: Form — how we make the past simple.
exercises.instructionUz: Yasalishi — oddiy o'tgan zamon qanday hosil bo'ladi.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI TO'RT QOIDA:

  1) Ko'pchilik TO'G'RI fe'lning TASDIQ shaklini
     fe'lga -ED qo'shib yasaymiz.
        I work  →  I worked

  2) Boshqa fe'llarning NOTO'G'RI tasdiq shakli bor.
        I see  →  I saw
     (Kitobning oxiridagi noto'g'ri fe'llar ro'yxatiga qarang.)

  3) Oddiy o'tgan zamonning SO'ROQ shaklini
     DID + KISHILIK OLMOSHI + FE'LNING ASOSIY SHAKLI
     bilan yasaymiz.
        DID HE WORK yesterday?
        DID YOU SEE Tom yesterday?

  4) INKOR shaklini DIDN'T + FE'LNING ASOSIY SHAKLI
     bilan yasaymiz.
        I DIDN'T WORK yesterday.
        I DIDN'T SEE Tom yesterday.

  5) Ijobiy qisqa javobni DID bilan,
     salbiy qisqa javobni DIDN'T bilan yasaymiz.
        Did you call me?  →  Yes, I DID.
        Did he tell you?  →  No, he DIDN'T.

DIQQAT — 3 va 4-QOIDALARDAGI ENG MUHIM SO'Z:
  'BASE FORM OF THE VERB' = fe'lning ASOSIY shakli.
  Ya'ni lug'atdagi shakl: work, see, go, have.
  O'tgan shakl EMAS: worked, saw, went, had.

  NOTO'G'RI FE'LLARDA bu ayniqsa muhim:
     Did you SEE Tom?    ✓
     Did you SAW Tom?    ✗ XATO
     I didn't SEE Tom.   ✓
     I didn't SAW Tom.   ✗ XATO

tasks.en: Form — how we make the past simple.
tasks.uz: Yasalishi — oddiy o'tgan zamon qanday hosil bo'ladi.

tasks.en: We form the affirmative of most regular verbs by adding -ed to the verb. I work - I worked
tasks.uz: Ko'pchilik to'g'ri fe'lning tasdiq shaklini -ed qo'shib yasaymiz.
tasks.note: KITOBDAGI 1-QOIDA.

tasks.en: Other verbs have irregular affirmative forms. I see - I saw
tasks.uz: Boshqa fe'llarning noto'g'ri tasdiq shakli bor.
tasks.note:
KITOBDAGI 2-QOIDA.
see → SAW.  Ro'yxat kitob oxirida.

tasks.en: We form the interrogative of past simple with did + subject pronoun + base form of the verb. Did he work yesterday? Did you see Tom yesterday?
tasks.uz: So'roqni did + kishilik olmoshi + fe'lning asosiy shakli bilan yasaymiz.
tasks.note:
KITOBDAGI 3-QOIDA.
'base form' = ASOSIY shakl (work, see).
'Did you saw?' XATO.

tasks.en: We form the negative of past simple with didn't + base form of the verb. I didn't work yesterday. I didn't see Tom yesterday.
tasks.uz: Inkorni didn't + fe'lning asosiy shakli bilan yasaymiz.
tasks.note:
KITOBDAGI 4-QOIDA.
'I didn't saw' XATO.

tasks.en: We form positive short answers with did and negative short answers with didn't. Did you call me? Yes, I did. Did he tell you? No, he didn't.
tasks.uz: Ijobiy qisqa javobni did, salbiyni didn't bilan yasaymiz.
tasks.note:
KITOBDAGI 5-QOIDA.
Asosiy fe'l takrorlanmaydi.

exercises.instructionEn: Spelling rules.
exercises.instructionUz: Yozilish qoidalari.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI UCH QOIDA:

  1) Oxiri -E bilan tugagan fe'lga -D qo'shamiz.
        I live  →  I lived

  2) UNDOSH + Y bilan tugagan fe'lda -Y tushadi,
     o'rniga -IED qo'shiladi.
        I marry  →  I married

  3) IKKI UNDOSH ORASIDA BITTA URG'ULI UNLI bo'lgan
     fe'lda oxirgi undosh IKKILANADI, so'ng -ED qo'shiladi.
        I stop  →  I stopped

3-QOIDANI BATAFSIL TUSHUNTIRAMIZ:

  'stop' so'zini ko'ring:  s-T-O-P
     'o' — unli, ikki tomonida undosh (t va p)
     va u URG'ULI (bir bo'g'inli so'z — urg'u shu yerda)
     → oxirgi undosh 'p' IKKILANADI → stoPPed

  Boshqa misollar:
     plan  → planned   (a — urg'uli, n ikkilanadi)
     stop  → stopped
     shop  → shopped
     drop  → dropped

  IKKILANMAYDIGAN holatlar:
     visit  → visited   (urg'u BIRINCHI bo'g'inda: VI-sit)
     open   → opened    (urg'u birinchi bo'g'inda: O-pen)
     rain   → rained    (ikki unli: 'ai')
     work   → worked    (ikki undosh: 'rk')

  BRITANCHA ISTISNO:
     travel → travelled  (britanchada L DOIM ikkilanadi,
                          urg'u birinchi bo'g'inda bo'lsa ham)
     Amerikachada: traveled.

QO'ShIMCHA (kitobda yo'q, lekin bilish kerak):
  UNLI + Y bo'lsa, -Y QOLADI:
     play → played;  enjoy → enjoyed;  stay → stayed

tasks.en: Spelling rules.
We add -d to verbs ending in -e. I live - I lived
tasks.note:
KITOBDAGI 1-QOIDA.
'liveed' EMAS.
love → loved;  care → cared;  die → died.

tasks.en: Verbs ending in a consonant + y drop the -y and add -ied. I marry - I married
tasks.uz: Undosh + y bilan tugagan fe'lda -y tushib, -ied qo'shiladi.
tasks.note:
KITOBDAGI 2-QOIDA.
study → studied;  bury → buried;  tidy → tidied.
DIQQAT: UNLI + y bo'lsa -y QOLADI (play → played).

tasks.en: Verbs ending in one stressed vowel between two consonants double the last consonant and add -ed. I stop - I stopped
tasks.uz: Ikki undosh orasida bitta urg'uli unli bo'lgan fe'lda oxirgi undosh ikkilanadi.
tasks.note:
KITOBDAGI 3-QOIDA.
stop → stopped;  plan → planned;  shop → shopped.
DIQQAT: urg'u OXIRGI bo'g'inda bo'lishi kerak —
'visit' da urg'u birinchi bo'g'inda → visited (ikkilanmaydi).

exercises.instructionEn: Use and Time Expressions.
exercises.instructionUz: Ishlatilishi va vaqt iboralari.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QOIDA (Use):

  Oddiy o'tgan zamonni O'TMISHDA ANIQ BIR VAQTDA
  sodir bo'lgan yoki tugagan harakatlar uchun ishlatamiz.

     He GRADUATED in 1998.
     (When did he graduate? In 1998.)

  ENG MUHIM SO'Z: 'a DEFINITE time' = ANIQ vaqt.
  Ya'ni voqea QACHON bo'lgani ma'lum.

VAQT IBORALARI (past simple bilan ishlatiladi):

  yesterday                      kecha
  last night                     kecha kechqurun
  last week / year / Monday      o'tgan hafta/yil/dushanba
  a month ago                    bir oy oldin
  two years ago                  ikki yil oldin
  three years ago                uch yil oldin
  in 1964                        1964-yilda

IKKI GURUH — JOYI HAR XIL:

  'LAST ...' → gap OXIRIDA yoki BOSHIDA
     I saw him last week.
     Last week I saw him.

  '... AGO' → 'ago' DOIM oxirida turadi
     I saw him two years AGO.
     'ago two years' XATO.

DIQQAT — 'LAST' va 'AGO' BIRGA ISHLATILMAYDI:
     last week        ✓
     a week ago       ✓
     last week ago    ✗ XATO

DIQQAT — 'IN + YIL':
     in 1964, in 1998 — yil oldidan DOIM IN.

YANGI SO'Z:
  to graduate = (o'quv yurtini) tugatmoq, bitirmoq
  a graduate  = bitiruvchi

tasks.uz: Oddiy o'tgan zamonni o'tmishda aniq bir vaqtda sodir bo'lgan yoki tugagan harakatlar uchun ishlatamiz.
tasks.note:
KITOBDAGI QOIDA.
'a definite time' = ANIQ vaqt.

tasks.en: He graduated in 1998. (When did he graduate? In 1998.)
tasks.note:
KITOBDAGI MISOL.
'to graduate' = o'quv yurtini tugatmoq.
Qavs ichida savol-javob bilan 'aniq vaqt' ko'rsatilgan.

tasks.en: yesterday
tasks.note: Gap oxirida yoki boshida turadi.

tasks.en: last night / week / year / Monday
tasks.uz: kecha kechqurun / o'tgan hafta / yil / dushanba
tasks.note: 'last' — predlogsiz, 'in last week' XATO.

tasks.uz: bir oy / ikki yil / uch yil oldin
tasks.note:
'ago' DOIM oxirida.
'last' bilan BIRGA ishlatilmaydi.
Yil oldidan DOIM IN.

exercises.instructionEn: A/An/The — the rules.
exercises.instructionUz: A/An/The — qoidalar.
exercises.explanationUz:
ASOSIY QOIDA:

  A/AN — biror narsa haqida BIRINCHI MARTA gapirganda
  THE  — ILGARI AYTILGAN narsa haqida gapirganda

  MISOL:
     There's A dog in the garden.       (birinchi marta)
     THE dog is near the swimming-pool. (o'sha it)

THE QO'YILADI:

  • daryo nomlari      → the Nile, the Amazon
  • dengiz nomlari     → the Mediterranean Sea
  • okean nomlari      → the Pacific, the Atlantic
  • tog' tizmalari     → the Himalayas, the Alps
  • millat nomlari     → the Polish, the Italians
  • oila nomlari       → the Johnsons, the Browns
  • qabila nomlari     → the Navajo, the Inuit

THE QO'YILMAYDI:

  • atoqli otlar       → Paul, Warsaw
  • mamlakat nomlari   → Spain, Turkey
  • ovqat nomlari      → dinner, breakfast
  • sport/o'yin nomlari → basketball, cards

ESLATMA — 'THE INUIT':
  Workbook 39-betdagi matn aynan inuitlar haqida edi.
  Qabila nomi bo'lgani uchun 'THE Inuit' deb yoziladi.

ESLATMA — MILLAT NOMLARIDA IKKI SHAKL:
  the Polish   — 'the' + SIFAT (butun xalq)
  the Italians — 'the' + KO'PLIK OT (butun xalq)
  Ikkalasi ham to'g'ri, faqat shakli boshqacha.

A yoki AN — TOVUShGA qaraladi, yozilishga emas:
  UNDOSH tovush → A   (a dog, a university /juː/)
  UNLI tovush   → AN  (an egg, an hour /aʊ/ — 'h' jim)

DIQQAT — MAMLAKAT NOMLARIDAGI ISTISNO:
  Oddiy nomlarda THE yo'q: Spain, Turkey, Uzbekistan
  Lekin ko'plik yoki 'union/kingdom/republic' bo'lsa THE:
     the USA, the UK, the Netherlands, the Philippines

tasks.en: A/An/The — the rules.
We use a/an to talk about something for the first time.
tasks.uz: A/an ni birinchi marta aytilgan narsa uchun ishlatamiz.
tasks.note: KITOBDAGI 1-QOIDA.

tasks.en: We use the to talk about something we have mentioned before.
tasks.uz: The ni ilgari aytilgan narsa uchun ishlatamiz.
tasks.note: KITOBDAGI 2-QOIDA.

tasks.en: There's a dog in the garden. The dog is near the swimming-pool.
tasks.uz: Bog'da it bor. It suzish havzasi yonida.
tasks.note:
KITOBDAGI MISOL — A → THE o'zgarishi.
DIQQAT: 'the garden' da ham THE bor —
chunki gaplashuvchilar qaysi bog' ekanini bilishadi.

exercises.instructionEn: Pronunciation of 'the'.
exercises.instructionUz: 'the' ning talaffuzi.
exercises.explanationUz:
'THE' IKKI XIL O'QILADI:

  /ðə/  — UNDOSH tovush bilan boshlangan so'z oldidan
           the glass  /ðə ɡlɑːs/
           the baby   /ðə ˈbeɪbi/

  /ðiː/ — UNLI tovush bilan boshlangan so'z oldidan
           the egg    /ðiː eɡ/
           the apple  /ðiː ˈæpl/

QOIDA 'A/AN' BILAN BIR XIL MANTIQDA:
  a dog / an egg
  the /ðə/ dog / the /ðiː/ egg

DIQQAT — TOVUShGA QARALADI, HARFGA EMAS:

  'university' — U harfi bilan boshlanadi, lekin
     /juːnɪˈvɜːsɪti/ deb o'qiladi — 'y' TOVUSHI (undosh).
     → A university,  the /ðə/ university

  'hour' — H harfi bilan boshlanadi, lekin
     /aʊə/ deb o'qiladi — 'h' JIM, unli tovush.
     → AN hour,  the /ðiː/ hour

  'honest' — 'h' jim → an honest man, the /ðiː/ honest man

AMALIY MASLAHAT:
  So'zni ovoz chiqarib ayting. Birinchi TOVUSH unli bo'lsa
  → /ðiː/;  undosh bo'lsa → /ðə/.

tasks.en: Pronunciation of 'the'.
The is pronounced /ðə/ before words which begin with a consonant sound: the glass, the baby
tasks.uz: 'the' undosh tovush bilan boshlangan so'z oldidan /ðə/ deb o'qiladi.
tasks.note:
KITOBDAGI 1-QOIDA.
Qisqa, kuchsiz talaffuz.

tasks.en: The is pronounced /ðiː/ before words which begin with a vowel sound: the egg, the apple
tasks.uz: 'the' unli tovush bilan boshlangan so'z oldidan /ðiː/ deb o'qiladi.
tasks.note:
KITOBDAGI 2-QOIDA.
Uzun 'i' tovushi.

tasks.en: a university → the /ðə/ university
tasks.note:
TOVUShGA qaraladi: /juː/ — UNDOSH tovush.
Shuning uchun 'A university' va /ðə/.

tasks.en: an hour → the /ðiː/ hour
tasks.note:
'h' O'QILMAYDI → /aʊə/ — UNLI tovush.
Shuning uchun 'AN hour' va /ðiː/.

exercises.instructionEn: Will (for predictions) — the table.
exercises.instructionUz: Will (bashorat uchun) — jadval.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ JADVAL — UZUN va QISQA SHAKLLAR:

  TASDIQ                        INKOR
  UZUN          QISQA           UZUN            QISQA
  I will go     I'll go         I will not go   I won't go
  you will go   you'll go       you will not go you won't go
  he will go    he'll go        he will not go  he won't go
  she will go   she'll go       she will not go she won't go
  it will go    it'll go        it will not go  it won't go
  we will go    we'll go        we will not go  we won't go
  you will go   you'll go       you will not go you won't go
  they will go  they'll go      they will not go they won't go

UCH MUHIM QOIDA:

  1) 'WILL' HAMMA EGA UCHUN BIR XIL.
        he wills  ✗ XATO

  2) 'will' dan keyin fe'l ASOSIY shaklda, 'to' SIZ:
        He will GO.        ✓
        He will TO go.     ✗ XATO
        He will GOES.      ✗ XATO
        He will WENT.      ✗ XATO

  3) SO'ROQda 'do/does/did' KERAK EMAS —
     'will' o'zi gap boshiga chiqadi:
        WILL he go?        ✓
        Does he will go?   ✗ XATO

QISQARTMALAR:
  I will   → I'LL      /aɪl/
  you will → YOU'LL    /juːl/
  he will  → HE'LL     /hiːl/
  she will → SHE'LL
  it will  → IT'LL
  we will  → WE'LL     /wiːl/
  they will → THEY'LL

  will not → WON'T     /wəʊnt/
  DIQQAT: 'willn't' shakli YO'Q!
  'won't' — yozilishi butunlay boshqacha, yodlash kerak.

ISHLATILISHI — BASHORAT:
  'will' ni kelajak haqidagi FIKR va TAXMIN uchun
  ishlatamiz.
     I think it will rain tomorrow.
     Perhaps they will win the match.

BASHORAT SO'ZLARI ('will' bilan birga):
  I think ...   = menimcha
  I hope ...    = umid qilaman
  Perhaps ...   = ehtimol
  Maybe ...     = balki
  I'm sure ...  = ishonchim komil

sections.titleUz: Will — so'roq shakli, yasalishi va ishlatilishi

exercises.instructionEn: Will — interrogative and short answers.
exercises.instructionUz: Will — so'roq shakli va qisqa javoblar.
exercises.explanationUz:
SO'ROQ JADVALI:

  Will I go?        Will we go?
  Will you go?      Will you go?
  Will he go?       Will they go?
  Will she go?
  Will it go?

QISQA JAVOBLAR:
  Will you/he, etc go out tonight?
     → Yes, I/you/he, etc WILL.
     → No,  I/you/he, etc WON'T.

KITOBDAGI FORM QOIDALARI:

  1) Kelasi zamonning TASDIQ shaklini
     WILL + FE'LNING ASOSIY SHAKLI bilan yasaymiz.
        I'LL SEE you tomorrow.

  2) SO'ROQ shaklini
     WILL + KISHILIK OLMOSHI + FE'LNING ASOSIY SHAKLI
     bilan yasaymiz.
        WILL YOU COME tomorrow?

  3) INKOR shaklini
     WON'T + FE'LNING ASOSIY SHAKLI bilan yasaymiz.
        I WON'T SEE Judy.

UCHALA QOIDADA HAM BIR XIL SO'Z:
  'BASE FORM OF THE VERB' = fe'lning ASOSIY shakli.
     see, come, go — 'saw', 'came', 'went' EMAS.

DIQQAT — PAST SIMPLE BILAN SOLISHTIRING:
  past simple so'roq:  DID you come?
  future simple so'roq: WILL you come?
  Ikkalasida ham fe'l ASOSIY shaklda — bu umumiy qoida.

USE (ishlatilishi):
  'will' ni BASHORAT qilish uchun ishlatamiz.
     I think HE'LL COME tomorrow.

VAQT IBORALARI (will bilan ishlatiladi):
  after            keyin
  tomorrow         ertaga
  next week        keyingi hafta
  next year        keyingi yil
  next month       keyingi oy
  tonight          bugun kechqurun
  soon             tez orada

SOLISHTIRING — 42-BETDAGI PAST SIMPLE IBORALARI:
  O'TGAN:  yesterday, last week, ... ago, in 1964
  KELASI:  tomorrow, next week, tonight, soon
  Vaqt iborasi zamonni ANIQLAB beradi.

tasks.en: Will — interrogative and short answers.
tasks.uz: Will — so'roq shakli va qisqa javoblar.

tasks.en: Will I go? Will you go? Will he go? Will she go? Will it go? Will we go? Will they go?
tasks.note:
SO'ROQda 'will' gap boshiga chiqadi.
Hamma ega uchun bir xil.

tasks.en: Will you/he, etc go out tonight? — Yes, I/you/he, etc will. No, I/you/he, etc won't.
tasks.note:
Qisqa javobda 'will/won't' takrorlanadi,
asosiy fe'l TAKRORLANMAYDI.
'go out' = tashqariga chiqmoq (sayr, ko'ngilochar).

tasks.en: We form the affirmative of the future simple with will + base form of the verb. I'll see you tomorrow.
tasks.uz: Kelasi zamonning tasdiq shaklini will + fe'lning asosiy shakli bilan yasaymiz.
tasks.note:
KITOBDAGI 1-QOIDA.
'I'll' = 'I will' ning qisqa shakli.

tasks.en: We form the interrogative with will + subject pronoun + base form of the verb. Will you come tomorrow?
tasks.uz: So'roqni will + kishilik olmoshi + fe'lning asosiy shakli bilan yasaymiz.
tasks.note:
KITOBDAGI 2-QOIDA.
'Will you came?' XATO.

tasks.en: We form the negative with won't + base form of the verb. I won't see Judy.
tasks.uz: Inkorni won't + fe'lning asosiy shakli bilan yasaymiz.
tasks.note:
KITOBDAGI 3-QOIDA.
'won't' = will not.

tasks.en: We use will to make predictions. I think he'll come tomorrow.
tasks.note:
KITOBDAGI USE qoidasi.
'I think' — bashorat so'zi.

tasks.en: Time Expressions: after, tomorrow, next week/year/month, tonight, soon, etc.
tasks.uz: Vaqt iboralari: keyin, ertaga, keyingi hafta/yil/oy, bugun kechqurun, tez orada.
tasks.note:
Bu so'zlar KELASI zamonni bildiradi.
42-betdagi past simple iboralari bilan solishtiring.

exercises.instructionEn: Linking Words: and, because, but, until, when
exercises.instructionUz: Bog'lovchilar: and, because, but, until, when
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QOIDA:
  Bog'lovchilarni gaplarni BIRLAShTIRISH uchun ishlatamiz.

BESH BOG'LOVCHI VA KITOBDAGI MISOLLAR:

  AND — qo'shimcha ma'lumot qo'shadi
     Tony worked hard AND became famous.
     (Toni ko'p ishladi va mashhur bo'ldi.)

  BECAUSE — SABABNI ko'rsatadi
     Mary left early BECAUSE she wanted to catch the bus.
     (Meri erta ketdi, chunki avtobusga yetib olmoqchi edi.)

  BUT — QARAMA-QARShILIKNI ko'rsatadi
     Bob had a lot of money BUT he lost it all.
     (Bobda ko'p pul bor edi, lekin hammasini yo'qotdi.)

  UNTIL — harakatning OXIRINI ko'rsatadi
     She continued travelling UNTIL the day she died.
     (U vafot etgan kunigacha sayohat qilishda davom etdi.)

  WHEN — VAQTNI ko'rsatadi
     I learned to play tennis WHEN I was five.
     (Besh yoshimda tennis o'ynashni o'rgandim.)

QAY BIRINI TANLASH — SAVOL BERING:

  Ikkinchi gap SABABNI aytadimi?      → BECAUSE
  Ikkinchi gap QARAMA-QARShIMI?       → BUT
  Ikkinchi gap QACHONligini aytadimi? → WHEN
  Birinchi harakat QACHONGACHA davom etdi? → UNTIL
  Shunchaki QO'ShIMCHA ma'lumotmi?    → AND

DIQQAT — 'BUT' OLDIDAN VERGUL:
  Bob had a lot of money, BUT he lost it all.
  ('and' oldidan odatda vergul qo'yilmaydi.)

DIQQAT — 'BECAUSE' va 'SO' FARQI:
  ...BECAUSE... → SABAB keladi
     He was tired BECAUSE he worked hard.
  ...SO...      → NATIJA keladi
     He worked hard, SO he was tired.
  Ma'no bir xil, tartib teskari.

DIQQAT — 'UNTIL' va 'WHEN' FARQI:
  UNTIL — harakat O'ShA PAYTGACHA davom etadi

exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni oddiy o'tgan zamonga qo'ying. Qaysi fe'llar noto'g'ri?
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ MATN (to'ldirilgan holda):

  Charles Dickens WAS a famous English writer. He was born
  in Portsmouth, England on 7th February, 1812. He WENT to
  school at the age of nine but he didn't finish his
  education. In 1824, he WORKED at a shoe polish factory
  and WENT back to school a year later. He TOOK a job as a
  legal clerk in 1827 and ENJOYED success as a reporter two
  years later.

  Dickens MARRIED Catherine Hogarth in 1836. He WROTE 'The
  Pickwick Papers' that same year. This book MADE him
  famous. He wrote many popular books and was considered to
  be England's finest writer.

  He DIVORCED his wife in 1858 and DIED on 9th June, 1870.
  They BURIED him in Westminster Abbey.


O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Charlz Dikkens mashhur ingliz yozuvchisi edi. U 1812-yil
  7-fevralda Angliyaning Portsmut shahrida tug'ilgan.
  To'qqiz yoshida maktabga bordi, lekin ta'limini
  tugatmadi. 1824-yilda poyabzal moyi fabrikasida ishladi
  va bir yildan keyin maktabga qaytdi. 1827-yilda huquqiy
  kotib bo'lib ishga kirdi va ikki yildan keyin muxbir
  sifatida muvaffaqiyatga erishdi.
  Dikkens 1836-yilda Ketrin Xogartga uylandi. O'sha yili
  'Pikvik klubi yozuvlari' ni yozdi. Bu kitob uni mashhur
  qildi. U ko'plab mashhur kitoblar yozdi va Angliyaning
  eng zo'r yozuvchisi deb hisoblanardi.
  U 1858-yilda xotinidan ajrashdi va 1870-yil 9-iyunda
  vafot etdi. Uni Vestminster abbatligida dafn etishdi.


SAVOLGA JAVOB — QAYSI FE'LLAR NOTO'G'RI?
  be    → WAS    (1-band)
  go    → WENT   (2 va 4-bandlar)
  take  → TOOK   (5-band)
  write → WROTE  (8-band)
  make  → MADE   (9-band)

  Qolganlari TO'G'RI fe'l:
  worked, enjoyed, married, divorced, died, buried

DIQQAT — 'ENJOY' → 'ENJOYED':
  'y' oldida UNLI ('o') → -IED qoidasi ISHLAMAYDI.
  2-mashqdagi 'play → played' bilan bir xil.

DIQQAT — 'BURY' → 'BURIED':
  'y' oldida UNDOSH ('r') → -IED qo'shiladi.

CHARLZ DIKKENS HAQIDA:
  Ingliz adabiyotining eng mashhur yozuvchilaridan biri.
  Asarlari: 'Oliver Twist', 'David Copperfield',
  'A Christmas Carol', 'The Pickwick Papers'.
  Bolaligida kambag'allikni ko'rgan (fabrikada ishlagan) —
  shuning uchun asarlarida kambag'allar hayoti tasvirlangan.

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a shoe polish factory = poyabzal moyi fabrikasi
  a legal clerk         = huquqiy kotib
  success               = muvaffaqiyat
  a reporter            = muxbir
  to be considered      = hisoblanmoq
  finest                = eng zo'r (fine ning ustun darajasi)
  an abbey              = abbatlik (katta cherkov)

DIQQAT: bu yerda 'divorce' to'ldiruvchi bilan —
'divorced HIS WIFE' (xotinidan ajrashdi).

'ON 9th June, 1870' — aniq sana → ON.

bury → BURIED. TO'G'RI fe'l.
'r' undosh + 'y' → -IED.
O'qilishi /ˈberid/.
'Westminster Abbey' — Londondagi mashhur abbatlik;

SAVOL QOLIPI:
  WHEN WAS THE LAST TIME YOU ...?
  = Oxirgi marta qachon ...?

SAKKIZ KO'RSATMA:
  write a letter?          xat yozmoq
  visit your grandparents? bobo-buvingizni ko'rgani bormoq
  buy new clothes?         yangi kiyim sotib olmoq
  tidy your room?          xonangizni yig'ishtirmoq
  wash the car?            mashinani yuvmoq
  have a haircut?          soch oldirmoq
  get a present?           sovg'a olmoq
  have a party?            ziyofat qilmoq

VAQT IBORALARI:
  yesterday                       kecha
  yesterday morning/evening, etc  kecha ertalab/kechqurun
  two days/weeks, etc ago         ikki kun/hafta oldin
  last Monday/Tuesday, etc        o'tgan dushanba/seshanba
  a week/month, etc ago           bir hafta/oy oldin

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  SA: When was the last time you wrote a letter?
  SB: The last time I wrote a letter was two days ago.
      How about you?
  SA: The last time I wrote a letter was a month ago.

ENG MUHIM DIQQAT — SAVOLDA VA JAVOBDA IKKALASIDA HAM
O'TGAN SHAKL:
  When was the last time you WROTE a letter?   ✓

  Sababi: bu yerda 'did' YO'Q — 'was' bor.
  Shuning uchun asosiy fe'l O'TGAN shaklda qoladi.
  Bu — 17c-mashqdagi 'didn't + asosiy shakl' dan FARQ QILADI.

JAVOB QOLIPI:
  The last time I [o'tgan fe'l] ... WAS [vaqt].

DIQQAT — 'AGO' DOIM OXIRIDA:
  two days AGO;  a month AGO.
  'ago before' XATO.

DIQQAT — 'HOW ABOUT YOU?':
  = Sen-chi?  Savolni qaytarish uchun.
  'What about you?' ham to'g'ri.

exercises.instructionEn: Finally, write Mozart's biography.
exercises.instructionUz: Nihoyat, Motsartning tarjimai holini yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ TARJIMAI HOL (A va B ustunlari qo'shilgan holda):

  Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart was born in Salzburg, Austria, in
  1756. He loved music and learnt to play the violin very
  well. He started writing music when he was five. He
  toured around western Europe with his father, Leopold,
  and played music for kings and queens. Everyone admired
  the talented young man and they often invited him to
  their balls. In 1781, he married Constanze Weber, but
  life was difficult because he had money problems. Mozart
  continued writing music and performing at the royal
  courts of Europe until he died in 1791. He was only 35
  years old.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Volfgang Amadey Motsart 1756-yilda Avstriyaning Zalsburg
  shahrida tug'ilgan. U musiqani sevardi va skripka
  chalishni juda yaxshi o'rgandi. Besh yoshida musiqa
  yozishni boshladi. Otasi Leopold bilan G'arbiy Yevropa
  bo'ylab gastrol qildi va qirol va qirolichalar uchun
  musiqa chaldi. Hamma iqtidorli yigitga qoyil qolardi va
  uni tez-tez o'z ballariga taklif qilishardi. 1781-yilda
  u Konstansa Veberga uylandi, lekin hayot og'ir edi,
  chunki moliyaviy muammolari bor edi. Motsart 1791-yilda
  vafot etgunicha musiqa yozishni va Yevropa saroylarida
  chiqish qilishni davom ettirdi. U atigi 35 yoshda edi.

UNIT MAVZUSI BILAN BOG'LIQLIGI:
  'The Price of Fame' — shuhratning narxi.
  Motsart butun Yevropada mashhur edi, qirollar uni
  taklif qilardi — lekin PULI YO'Q edi va 35 yoshda
  vafot etdi. Diana kabi, u ham shuhrat uchun 'narx' to'ladi.

DIQQAT — 'ONLY' JOYI:
  'He was ONLY 35 years old' = atigi 35 yoshda edi.
  'only' achinish ma'nosini beradi.

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  Salzburg      = Zalsburg (Avstriya shahri)
  a violin      = skripka
  to tour       = gastrol qilmoq
  western Europe = G'arbiy Yevropa
  to admire     = qoyil qolmoq
  talented      = iqtidorli
  a ball        = bal, raqs kechasi
  money problems = moliyaviy muammolar
  to perform    = chiqish qilmoq
  the royal court = qirol saroyi

tasks.answer: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart was born in Salzburg, Austria, in 1756. He loved music and learnt to play the violin very well.
He started writing music when he was five.
He toured around western Europe with his father, Leopold, and played music for kings and queens.
Everyone admired the talented young man and they often invited him to their balls.
In 1781, he married Constanze Weber, but life was difficult because he had money problems.
Mozart continued writing music and performing at the royal courts of Europe until he died in 1791. He was only 35 years old.

exercises.instructionEn: How we write a biography.
exercises.instructionUz: Tarjimai hol qanday yoziladi.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

  Vafot etgan odam haqida tarjimai hol yozganimizda
  quyidagilar bilan BOSHLAYMIZ:
     • odamning TO'LIQ ISMI
     • u NIMA BILAN MASHHUR ekani
     • TUG'ILGAN SANASI va JOYI

  So'ng uning ERTA va KEYINGI yillaridagi MUHIM VOQEA
  va YUTUQLARI haqida XRONOLOGIK tartibda yozamiz.

  Tarjimai holni u QACHON va QAYERDA vafot etgani
  bilan TUGATAMIZ.

  O'TGAN ZAMONlarni ishlatamiz.

REJA (3 XATBOSHI):

  1-xatboshi: to'liq ism, nima bilan mashhur,
              tug'ilgan sana va joy
     ↓
  2-xatboshi: hayotidagi muhim sanalar XRONOLOGIK
              tartibda — erta yillar / keyingi yillar
     ↓
  3-xatboshi: vafoti haqida

DIQQAT — 'CHRONOLOGICAL ORDER':
  = vaqt tartibida, eng erta voqeadan boshlab.
  Sanalarni ARALASHTIRIB yozmang.

NAMUNA MATNLAR KITOBDA BOR:
  71-bet — Diana (5 xatboshi)
  73-bet, 13-mashq — Fleming (kitob shu matnni
                     NAMUNA qilib olishni so'raydi)
  73-bet, 16-mashq — Motsart

tasks.en: How we write a biography.
We start with the person's full name, what he/she is famous for and the date and place he/she was born.
tasks.uz: Odamning to'liq ismi, nima bilan mashhurligi va tug'ilgan sanasi va joyi bilan boshlaymiz.
tasks.note:
1-XATBOSHI mazmuni.
'famous FOR' — 'for' shart.

tasks.en: We then write about the important events/achievements in his/her early and later years in chronological order.
tasks.uz: So'ng erta va keyingi yillaridagi muhim voqea va yutuqlar haqida xronologik tartibda yozamiz.
tasks.note:
2-XATBOSHI mazmuni.
'an achievement' = yutuq.
'chronological order' = vaqt tartibi.

tasks.en: We end the biography with when and where he/she died.
tasks.uz: Tarjimai holni u qachon va qayerda vafot etgani bilan tugatamiz.
tasks.note:
3-XATBOSHI mazmuni.
'to end with ...' = ...bilan tugatmoq.

tasks.en: We use past tenses.
tasks.note:
was/were, had, past simple (-ed va noto'g'ri fe'llar).
Hozirgi zamon ISHLATILMAYDI.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the plan below and information from Ex. 22, to write a short biography of Antonio Vivaldi. Use Ex. 13 as a model.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi rejadan va 22-mashqdagi ma'lumotdan foydalanib Antonio Vivaldining qisqa tarjimai holini yozing. 13-mashqni namuna qilib oling.
exercises.explanationUz:
MA'LUMOT 22-MASHQDAN OLINADI:
  • bastakor va skripkachi
  • Venetsiyada tug'ilgan, 1678-yil 4-mart
  • 25 yoshida ruhoniy bo'lgan
  • Venetsiyadagi QIZLAR maktabida musiqa o'rgatgan
  • ko'p mamlakatlarga sayohat qilgan
  • 40 opera, 39 fagot konserti, 30 nay konserti yozgan
  • cho'qqisida boy edi
  • hech qachon uylanmagan
  • 1741-yil 28-iyulda kambag'al holda vafot etgan

TO'LIQ NAMUNA MATN:

  Antonio Vivaldi was a famous Italian composer and
  violinist. He was born on 4th March, 1678, in Venice,
  Italy.

  At the age of twenty-five, he became a priest. He taught
  music at a school for girls in Venice. He travelled to
  many countries and wrote a lot of music. He composed 40
  operas, 39 concertos for bassoon and 30 concertos for
  flute. At the height of his career, he was a rich and
  famous man.

  Vivaldi never married. He was poor when he died on 28th
  July, 1741.


O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Antonio Vivaldi mashhur italyan bastakori va
  skripkachisi edi. U 1678-yil 4-martda Italiyaning
  Venetsiya shahrida tug'ilgan.
  Yigirma besh yoshida ruhoniy bo'ldi. Venetsiyadagi
  qizlar maktabida musiqa o'rgatdi. Ko'p mamlakatlarga
  sayohat qildi va juda ko'p musiqa yozdi. U 40 ta opera,
  fagot uchun 39 ta va nay uchun 30 ta konsert bastaladi.
  Faoliyatining cho'qqisida u boy va mashhur odam edi.
  Vivaldi hech qachon uylanmadi. U 1741-yil 28-iyulda
  kambag'al holda vafot etdi.

DIQQAT — NOTO'G'RI FE'LLAR:
  become → BECAME
  teach  → TAUGHT
  write  → WROTE
  Qolganlari to'g'ri: travelled, composed, married, died.

DIQQAT — 'TRAVELLED' YOZILISHI:
  Britanchada 'L' IKKILANADI: travel → travelled.
  Amerikachada bitta: traveled.

DIQQAT — 'NEVER MARRIED':
  'never' o'zi inkor — 'didn't' KERAK EMAS.
     He never married.        ✓
     He didn't never marry.   ✗ XATO

sentencePatterns.formula: WHO WAS + ism?  →  He/She WAS + a/an/the + kasb.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Who was John F. Kennedy? — He was an American president.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Jon F. Kennedi kim edi? — U amerikalik prezident edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Kasb oldidan artikl SHART.
Ko'pchilikdan biri → a/an;  yagona unvon → the.

sentencePatterns.formula: WHEN WAS he/she BORN?  →  He/She WAS BORN IN + yil.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: When was he born? — He was born in 1917.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U qachon tug'ilgan? — U 1917-yilda tug'ilgan.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'be born' — MAJHUL nisbat, 'was/were' SHART.
'I born' XATO.  Yil oldidan IN.

sentencePatterns.formula: WHEN DID he/she DIE?  →  He/She DIED IN + yil.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: When did he die? — He died in 1963.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U qachon vafot etgan? — U 1963-yilda vafot etgan.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
So'roqda 'did' + ASOSIY shakl (die).
Javobda fe'lning o'tgan shakli (died).
'was died' XATO — 'die' majhul nisbat olmaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: She worked AS a + kasb.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She worked as a nurse.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U hamshira bo'lib ishladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'work AS' = ...bo'lib ishlamoq — 'as' SHART.
'work like a nurse' boshqa ma'no beradi.

sentencePatterns.formula: The British LOVED her FOR her + fazilat.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The British loved her for her kindness and beauty.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Britaniyaliklar uni mehribonligi va go'zalligi uchun sevishdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'love somebody FOR something' = biror fazilati uchun sevmoq.
'the British' — millat nomi oldidan THE.

sentencePatterns.formula: She DIED IN a + halokat turi.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She died in a car accident.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U avtohalokatda halok bo'ldi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'die IN an accident' — predlog IN.
'die OF an illness' — kasallikdan bo'lsa OF.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + WAS BORN ON + sana, IN + joy.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Diana Frances Spencer was born on 1st July, 1961, in Norfolk, England.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Diana Frensis Spenser 1961-yil 1-iyulda Angliyaning Norfolk shahrida tug'ilgan.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'be born' — MAJHUL nisbat.
Aniq sana → ON;  joy → IN.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + MARRIED + kim + IN + oy/yil + AT + bino.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She married Prince Charles in July, 1981, at St Paul's Cathedral in London.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U 1981-yil iyulda Londondagi Avliyo Pavel soborida shahzoda Charlzga turmushga chiqdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'marry somebody' — 'with' KERAK EMAS.

sentencePatterns.formula: They CALLED her "..." BECAUSE she ... .
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They called her "The People's Princess" because she cared so much about sick and poor people.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ular uni "Xalq Malikasi" deb atashdi, chunki u kasal va kambag'al odamlar haqida qayg'urardi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'call somebody + nom' — orada predlog YO'Q.
'because' sababni bog'laydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Her life wasn't AS happy AS it appeared.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: But Diana's life wasn't as happy as it appeared.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Lekin Diananing hayoti ko'ringanchalik baxtli emas edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'AS + sifat + AS' — tenglik darajasi.
Inkorda 'unchalik ...emas' ma'nosini beradi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + CONTINUED TO + fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Diana continued to travel round the world and help those in need.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Diana dunyo bo'ylab sayohat qilishni va muhtojlarga yordam berishni davom ettirdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'continue TO + fe'l' qolipi.
Ikkinchi fe'l ('help') oldidan 'to' takrorlanmaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + DIED ON + sana, IN + halokat, IN + shahar.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She died on 31st August, 1997, in a car accident in Paris.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U 1997-yil 31-avgustda Parijda avtohalokatda halok bo'ldi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'die' — oddiy fe'l ('was died' XATO).
Halokat va shahar bilan IN.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + WAS FAMOUS FOR + ot.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She was famous for her kindness and beauty.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U mehribonligi va go'zalligi bilan mashhur edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'famous FOR' — 'for' SHART.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + fe'l+ED (yoki noto'g'ri shakl) + ... + vaqt iborasi.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I watched TV last night. Diana married Prince Charles in July, 1981.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kecha kechqurun televizor ko'rdim. Diana 1981-yil iyulda shahzoda Charlzga turmushga chiqdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Tasdiq gapda fe'l O'TGAN shaklda.
Hamma ega uchun bir xil — -s yo'q.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + DIDN'T + ASOSIY fe'l.   /   DID + ega + ASOSIY fe'l?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I didn't cook dinner. Did you watch TV last night?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kechki ovqat pishirmadim. Kecha kechqurun televizor ko'rdingmi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'did/didn't' bor bo'lsa — fe'l ASOSIY shaklda.
Eng ko'p uchraydigan xato: 'didn't watched'.

sentencePatterns.formula: I + o'tgan fe'l + yesterday BUT I didn't + asosiy fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I made a cake yesterday but I didn't cook dinner.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kecha tort pishirdim, lekin kechki ovqat pishirmadim.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Bitta gapda IKKI xil shakl: 'made' (tasdiq) va 'cook' (inkor).

sentencePatterns.formula: X was born ON the [tartib son] OF [oy], [yil] and died ON ... .
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Elvis Presley was born on the eighth of January, nineteen thirty-five and died on the sixteenth of August, nineteen seventy-seven.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Elvis Presli 1935-yil 8-yanvarda tug'ilgan va 1977-yil 16-avgustda vafot etgan.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 1-USUL: the + tartib son + OF + oy.

sentencePatterns.formula: X was born ON [oy] THE [tartib son], [yil].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Elvis Presley was born on January the eighth, nineteen thirty-five.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Elvis Presli 1935-yil 8-yanvarda tug'ilgan.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 2-USUL: oy + THE + tartib son.  'of' YO'Q.

sentencePatterns.formula: WHEN/WHERE WAS he/she BORN?   ↔   WHEN DID he/she DIE?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: When was she born? — In 1867. When did she die? — In 1934.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U qachon tug'ilgan? — 1867-yilda. Qachon vafot etgan? — 1934-yilda.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'be born' — 'did' KERAK EMAS ('to be' bilan).
'die' — 'did' KERAK (oddiy fe'l).

sentencePatterns.formula: die IN an accident   ↔   die OF an illness.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Pièrre died in a road accident. She died of leukaemia.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Pyer yo'l-transport hodisasida halok bo'ldi. U leykemiyadan vafot etdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Halokat → IN;  kasallik → OF.
Bu farqni yodlab qo'yish kerak.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + o'tgan zamon fe'li + ... + IN + yil.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He discovered penicillin in 1928 and received the Nobel Prize for Medicine in 1945.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U 1928-yilda penitsillinni kashf etdi va 1945-yilda tibbiyot bo'yicha Nobel mukofotini oldi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Ikki harakat 'and' bilan bog'langan.
Yil oldidan IN.

sentencePatterns.formula: [rassom] PAINTED [asar].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Leonardo da Vinci painted the Mona Lisa.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Leonardo da Vinchi 'Mona Liza' ni chizgan.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
paint → painted (to'g'ri fe'l).
Majhul shakli: 'was painted by ...'.

sentencePatterns.formula: [bastakor] COMPOSED [asar].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Mozart composed Requiem. Vivaldi composed The Four Seasons.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Motsart 'Rekviyem' ni bastalagan. Vivaldi 'To'rt fasl' ni bastalagan.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: compose → composed (oxiri 'e' → faqat + D).

sentencePatterns.formula: He STARTED / CONTINUED + fe'l-ING.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He started writing music. Mozart continued writing music and performing.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U musiqa yozishni boshladi. Motsart musiqa yozishni va chiqish qilishni davom ettirdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'start' va 'continue' dan keyin -ing shakli keladi
('to' + fe'l ham to'g'ri).

sentencePatterns.formula: ... , BUT life was difficult BECAUSE he had ... .
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: In 1781, he married Constanze Weber, but life was difficult because he had money problems.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: 1781-yilda u Konstansa Veberga uylandi, lekin hayot og'ir edi, chunki moliyaviy muammolari bor edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'but' — qarama-qarshilik;  'because' — sabab.
Bitta gapda ikkalasi ham bo'lishi mumkin.

sentencePatterns.formula: He CONTINUED ... UNTIL he DIED in [yil].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Mozart continued writing music until he died in 1791.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Motsart 1791-yilda vafot etgunicha musiqa yozishni davom ettirdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'until' davom etgan harakatning OXIRINI ko'rsatadi.

sentencePatterns.formula: They BURIED him IN + joy.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They buried him in St Paul's Cathedral.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Uni Avliyo Pavel soborida dafn etishdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
bury → buried (undosh + Y → -IED).
'they' bu yerda aniq odamlar emas, umumiy ma'noda.

sentencePatterns.formula: WRONG! Ega + DIDN'T + ASOSIY fe'l + noto'g'ri ma'lumot. Ega + O'TGAN fe'l + to'g'ri ma'lumot.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Wrong! AJ didn't work as a model when he was three. He worked as a model when he was six.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Noto'g'ri! EY-Jey uch yoshida model bo'lib ishlamagan. U olti yoshida model bo'lib ishlagan.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Bir javobda IKKI xil shakl:
inkorda ASOSIY, tasdiqda O'TGAN.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + WASN'T + ... . It WAS ... .   ('be' fe'li uchun)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The fifth member wasn't Kevin. It was Brian Littrell.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Beshinchi a'zo Kevin emas edi. U Brayan Littrell edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'to be' fe'lida 'didn't' KERAK EMAS —
faqat 'wasn't/weren't'.

sentencePatterns.formula: WHEN WAS THE LAST TIME YOU + O'TGAN fe'l?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: When was the last time you wrote a letter?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Oxirgi marta qachon xat yozgan eding?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'did' YO'Q ('was' bor) → asosiy fe'l O'TGAN shaklda.
'you write' XATO — 'you WROTE'.

sentencePatterns.formula: The last time I + O'TGAN fe'l + ... WAS + vaqt ibora.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The last time I wrote a letter was two days ago.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Oxirgi marta ikki kun oldin xat yozgandim.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'ago' DOIM vaqt iborasining OXIRIDA.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + GOT TO KNOW + kim.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: When he was fourteen, he got to know Howie.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: O'n to'rt yoshida Xaui bilan tanishdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'get to know somebody' = kimdir bilan tanishmoq.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + JOINED + guruh.   /   Ega + RELEASED + albom.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Kevin joined the group. BSB released their first album in 1996.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kevin guruhga qo'shildi. BSB birinchi albomini 1996-yilda chiqardi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'join' dan keyin 'to' KERAK EMAS.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + USED TO + ASOSIY fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Nick used to dance there.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Nik u yerda raqsga tushardi (ilgari).
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: O'tmishdagi ODAT — endi takrorlanmaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: WHEN was the last time you + O'TGAN fe'l?  /  WHERE DID you + ASOSIY fe'l?  /  WHO DID you + ASOSIY fe'l + WITH?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: When was the last time you went shopping? — Where did you go? — Who did you go with?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Oxirgi marta qachon xaridga borgan eding? — Qayerga bording? — Kim bilan bording?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
1-savolda 'did' YO'Q → fe'l O'TGAN shaklda (went).
2 va 3-savolda 'did' BOR → fe'l ASOSIY shaklda (go).
'with' gap OXIRIDA.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + WAS + a famous + millat + kasb.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Antonio Vivaldi was a famous Italian composer and violinist.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Antonio Vivaldi mashhur italyan bastakori va skripkachisi edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Tarjimai holning 1-gapi.
Sifatlar tartibi: baho (famous) → millat (Italian) → kasb.

sentencePatterns.formula: AT THE AGE OF + son, he BECAME + kasb.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: At the age of twenty-five, he became a priest.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Yigirma besh yoshida u ruhoniy bo'ldi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
become → BECAME (noto'g'ri fe'l).
Kasb oldidan artikl SHART.

sentencePatterns.formula: AT THE HEIGHT OF his career, he WAS + sifat.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: At the height of his career, he was a rich and famous man.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Faoliyatining cho'qqisida u boy va mashhur odam edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'the height of one's career' = faoliyat cho'qqisi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + NEVER + o'tgan fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Vivaldi never married.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Vivaldi hech qachon uylanmadi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'never' o'zi INKOR — 'didn't' KERAK EMAS.
'didn't never' XATO (ikki inkor).

sentencePatterns.formula: He was POOR when he DIED ON + sana.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He was poor when he died on 28th July, 1741.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U 1741-yil 28-iyulda kambag'al holda vafot etdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Tarjimai holning oxirgi gapi.
Aniq sana → ON.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + fe'l+ED.   /   DID + ega + ASOSIY fe'l?   /   Ega + DIDN'T + ASOSIY fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I worked yesterday. Did he work yesterday? I didn't work yesterday.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kecha ishladim. U kecha ishladimi? Kecha ishlamadim.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'did/didn't' bor bo'lsa — fe'l ASOSIY shaklda.

sentencePatterns.formula: DID + ega + SEE ...?  →  Yes, I DID. / No, I DIDN'T.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Did you see Tom yesterday? — Yes, I did.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kecha Tomni ko'rdingmi? — Ha, ko'rdim.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Noto'g'ri fe'lda ham so'roqda ASOSIY shakl ('see').
Qisqa javobda faqat 'did'.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + o'tgan fe'l + IN + yil.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He graduated in 1998.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U 1998-yilda bitirdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Aniq vaqt ko'rsatilgan → past simple.

sentencePatterns.formula: There's A + ot ... . THE + o'sha ot ... .
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There's a dog in the garden. The dog is near the swimming-pool.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bog'da it bor. It suzish havzasi yonida.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Birinchi marta → A/AN;  ikkinchi marta → THE.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + WILL + ASOSIY fe'l.   /   Ega + WON'T + ASOSIY fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He will go. He won't go.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U boradi. U bormaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'will' dan keyin fe'l ASOSIY shaklda, 'to' siz.
Hamma ega uchun bir xil.

sentencePatterns.formula: WILL + ega + ASOSIY fe'l?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Will he go?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U boradimi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'will' gap boshiga chiqadi.
'do/does/did' KERAK EMAS.

sentencePatterns.formula: Ega + WILL + ASOSIY fe'l.   /   WILL + ega + ASOSIY fe'l?   /   Ega + WON'T + ASOSIY fe'l.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I'll see you tomorrow. Will you come tomorrow? I won't see Judy.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ertaga ko'rishamiz. Ertaga kelasanmi? Judini ko'rmayman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Uchala shaklda ham fe'l ASOSIY shaklda.

sentencePatterns.formula: WILL + ega + fe'l?  →  Yes, ... WILL. / No, ... WON'T.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Will you go out tonight? — Yes, I will. / No, I won't.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bugun kechqurun chiqasanmi? — Ha. / Yo'q.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: Qisqa javobda asosiy fe'l TAKRORLANMAYDI.

sentencePatterns.formula: 1-gap + AND / BUT + 2-gap.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Tony worked hard and became famous. Bob had a lot of money but he lost it all.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Toni ko'p ishladi va mashhur bo'ldi. Bobda ko'p pul bor edi, lekin hammasini yo'qotdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: AND — qo'shimcha;  BUT — qarama-qarshilik (oldidan vergul).

sentencePatterns.formula: 1-gap + BECAUSE + sabab.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Mary left early because she wanted to catch the bus.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Meri erta ketdi, chunki avtobusga yetib olmoqchi edi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'because' dan keyin SABAB keladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: 1-gap + UNTIL / WHEN + vaqt gapi.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She continued travelling until the day she died. I learned to play tennis when I was five.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U vafot etgan kunigacha sayohat qildi. Besh yoshimda tennis o'ynashni o'rgandim.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: UNTIL — harakatning OXIRI;  WHEN — harakat sodir bo'lgan PAYT.

sentencePatterns.formula: This book MADE him FAMOUS.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: This book made him famous.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu kitob uni mashhur qildi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: 'make somebody + sifat' — orada 'to' KERAK EMAS.
